# Dukan ko Stock ka Hisab Kyun Rakhein — 3 Important Points

**1. Customer ka Bharosa aur Demand Poori Karnaa**
Jab dukan ka malik stock ka hisab rakhta hai, toh woh jaanta hai ki kaunsa maal kitna pada hai. Isse woh kabhi bhi customer ko khali haath nahi bhejta — jo cheez customer chahta hai, woh hamesha available rehti hai. Na maal kam padta hai, na customer naraz hota hai. **3. Chori aur Leakage Pakadna**
Stock ki ginti karte rehne se pata chalta hai ki maal kahin gayab toh nahi ho raha. Agar hisaab aur asli maal mein farak dikhe, toh turant pata chal jaata hai ki koi galat kaam ho raha hai — chahe woh staff ki chori ho ya kharab maal ka waste.
